author: Joe Scott
description:
Sign up for my monthly newsletter at http://www.thatjoescott.com/newsletter!  

You’ve heard their names a million times. The diseases named after them may have personally affected your life or the life of a loved one. But who are these people? Why are these diseases named after them? Turns out many of them had a fascinating life story that you’ve never heard before. So we’re telling their story here in today’s video.
